title: DMP delivery
description: One recipient's delivery of a message (section 6), with the member names the conformance kit observes (section 12.4.7).

message.description: The id of the message delivered.

session.description: The session the delivery is bound to, as a `run:` address, or null.

via.description: The route that reached the recipient (section 3.7).

state.description: A state of section 6.1. `forwarded` and `refused` are Appendix F's, exposed only by a host that implements it (section 11.8).
